about: Indranil's glove renders (Blender, 20 Oct 2026, l_hand / x_hand, and G re-rendered the same day with the index pointing and a short thumb; JT chose L X G for Thursday's demo, right hand only) cut out of their black backgrounds by tools/ghost-hands/gloves/cut.py and saved 720 px on the long side. Each is a RIGHT hand as it looks on the learner's own (mirrored) screen. W is the wrist and M the middle finger's knuckle, as fractions of the image (x from the left, y from the top). They size and place the glove (experiments/asl-tutor/glove.js). G and X: where the site's hand model (MediaPipe hand_landmarker float16/1) found them on the renders recoloured to skin (tools/ghost-hands/gloves/detect.py), median of its readings, the wrist moved to where the hand meets the cuff. L: by eye on a 5% grid (the model cannot read the L render's fingers).
